parts:
Hello LAVAAN members

Quarto in RStudio: Writing Reproducible & Dynamic Research Papers led by Seraphine Maerz (School of Social and Political Science, University of Melbourne) is now available as an on-demand streaming seminar. This seminar introduces Quarto in RStudio, a powerful tool for creating reproducible and dynamically updated research papers. Researchers using R for latent variable analysis can integrate their lavaan code directly into Quarto documents, ensuring that all model outputs, tables, and figures are automatically generated and fully verifiable. This integration streamlines the entire workflow from analysis to manuscript, allowing you to efficiently update complex statistical reports and focus more on the substantive interpretation of your latent variable models.

Access this seminar at your own pace and please share this with colleagues and students who might benefit!


Best wishes

Michael Zyphur
Professor and Director
